description: Splits, dividends, symbol changes, mergers, delistings. Bars stay raw; adjustments are applied at read time only for actions whose ex date is at or before the decision time and whose ingested_at is not after the replay's as_of time (P0 audit A5.3).

columns.name: event_at
columns.description: Ex / effective date at 00:00 America/New_York, in UTC.

columns.name: action_type
columns.description: split | reverse_split | cash_dividend | stock_dividend | name_change | merger | spinoff | delisting.

columns.name: new_symbol
columns.description: Symbol after the action, if it changes.

columns.name: declared_at
columns.description: Declaration time if known; the earliest the action could be known.

columns.name: raw
columns.description: The vendor record as canonical JSON (sorted keys).

columns.name: ingested_at
columns.description: When the row was received. Alpaca gives no guarantee on creation time, so this bounds availability.
